headings: Broadband Internet: A mixture of various technologies to provide internet services for residential and small business customers capable of multi-gigabit speeds.

Wireless Service Bundle: Residential customers can bundle their Kinetic broadband service with a post-paid wireless service plan with AT&T.

Premium Technical Support: Add-on service offers 24/7 help with personal computer issues, device setup, network problems, virus removal, and software installation, accessible via chat, phone, or email.

Voice: Residential and small business voice services, delivered over traditional landline or digital means, include call management options and emergency access.

paragraphs: Uniti Group Inc. (herein referred to as the "Company," "Uniti," "we," "us," or "our") was incorporated in the State of Delaware on April 19, 2024, under the name "Windstream Parent, Inc" and as a subsidiary of New Windstream, LLC ("Windstream") (as successor to Windstream Holdings II, LLC) in connection with the Merger (as defined below).

Uniti is a premier digital infrastructure company with approximately 240,000 fiber route miles across 47 states. The Company serves more than 1.0 million customers, including more than 500,000 residential fiber customers, with a network that includes approximately 1.9 million fiber-equipped households predominately situated in the Midwest and Southeast United States of America ("U.S."). The Company offers a full suite of advanced communications services, including fiber-based broadband to residential and business customers, managed cloud communications and security services for large enterprises and government entities across the U.S., and tailored waves and transport solutions for carriers, content providers and large cloud computing and storage service providers in the U.S. and Canada. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company had total revenues and sales of $2,234.5 million and net income of $1,304.7 million.

Prior to the Merger, Uniti Group LLC (f/k/a Uniti Group Inc., "Old Uniti") was an independent internally managed real estate investment trust ("REIT") engaged in the acquisition, construction and leasing of mission critical infrastructure in the communications industry. Old Uniti managed its operations within two primary lines of business: Uniti Fiber and Uniti Leasing. Old Uniti operated through a customary "up-REIT" structure, pursuant to which it held substantially all of its assets through a partnership, Uniti Group LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the "Operating Partnership") that Old Uniti controlled as general partner. The up-REIT structure was intended to facilitate future acquisition opportunities by providing Old Uniti with the ability to use common units of the Operating Partnership as a tax-efficient acquisition currency. As of August 1, 2025, Old Uniti was the sole general partner of the Operating Partnership and owned 100.0% of the partnership interests in the Operating Partnership.

On August 1, 2025, pursuant to the previously announced Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of May 3, 2024 (as amended) (the "Merger Agreement"), by and between Old Uniti, Windstream, the Company, New Uniti HoldCo LP and New Windstream Merger Sub, LLC, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream ("Merger Sub"), Old Uniti and Windstream completed the following transactions: (a) Windstream merged with and into the Company (at such time, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream named Windstream Parent, Inc.), with the Company surviving the merger as the ultimate parent company of the combined company (the "Internal Reorg Merger"), and (b) Merger Sub merged with and into Old Uniti (the "Merger"), with Old Uniti surviving the Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Following the consummation of the Merger, the Company was renamed Uniti Group Inc., Old Uniti ceased to be a REIT, and the Company does not qualify to be a REIT. The common stock of the Company ("Common Stock") is listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "UNIT".

Subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger, each share of Old Uniti's common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, that was issued and outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Merger was automatically cancelled and retired and converted into the right to receive 0.6029 shares of Common Stock, par value $0.0001 per share, pursuant to the exchange ratio set forth in the Merger Agreement with cash issued in lieu of fractional shares. Immediately following the consummation of the Merger (the "Closing"), Old Uniti's and Windstream's pre-Closing stockholders held approximately 62% and 38%, respectively, of the Company before giving effect to the conversion of any outstanding convertible securities or the issuance of warrants to purchase Common Stock. The Merger was accounted for as a reverse merger using the acquisition method of accounting, with Windstream treated as the legal acquirer and Old Uniti treated as the accounting acquirer. See Note 1 and 4 to our consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8. "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data," of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information related to the completion of the Merger.

Following the Merger, our operations are organized into three business segments: Kinetic, Uniti Solutions and Fiber Infrastructure, which are described in more detail below and in Note 15 to our consolidated financial statements contained in Part II, Item 8. "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data". Refer to Part II, Item 7. "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Other Significant Developments," of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for information regarding significant developments in our business in 2025.

We manage as one business our residential, business and wholesale operations in markets in which we are the incumbent local exchange carrier ("ILEC") due to the similarities with respect to service offerings and marketing strategies. The Kinetic business unit is a premier provider of multi-gigabit fiber internet, whole-home Wi-Fi, internet security, and voice services in approximately 1,400 markets across 18 states in the Southwestern, Southeastern, Midwestern and Northeastern U.S. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Kinetic segment generated total revenues and sales of $928.4 million and contribution margin of $407.6 million.

Kinetic's objective is to profitably grow penetration of our broadband network by continuing to invest in and expand our fiber footprint, accelerating subscriber acquisition, reducing churn, and growing average revenue per customer. Consumer and small business bandwidth needs continue to grow at a rapid pace, driven by increasing demand for streaming video, videoconferencing, remote work, telemedicine, gaming, smart homes, and the proliferation of connected devices. In a competitive environment, our continued investments in expanding our fiber footprint are important to strengthen our competitive positioning and achieve our goal of sustained profitable growth.

Building fiber is a key driver of subscriber acquisition, retention, and revenue, and we expect it will become more important over time. We continue to replace copper lines with fiber to provide symmetrical gigabit + speeds, enhanced reliability, better support, and future-proof connectivity. In addition to investments in our broadband network, we are focused on delivering sustained profitable subscriber growth with compelling and valuable service and product offerings, marketing and sales effectiveness, and a better customer experience.

We offer consumers and small businesses a portfolio of services over both our fiber and copper networks, including broadband internet, voice, and other value-added services. Kinetic's residential and small business services include:

Customer Premise Equipment (CPE): Customers can lease an advanced Wi-Fi gateway from Kinetic. Specifically, residential customers can lease the eero Pro 7, which uses the latest, most advanced Wi-Fi 7 technology. When coupled with Kinetic's fiber internet, the eero Pro 7 delivers an enhanced online experience that is easy, secure, fast and affordable. We also offer state-of-the-art mesh extenders, allowing customers to enable strong signal throughout the entirety of their home.

The Kinetic Promise™: Included with Kinetic's Whole Home Wi-Fi installation, is a pledge that technicians will not leave a new fiber installation until Wi-Fi works in every room and on every device throughout the home. Professional technicians set up and install customers' Wi-Fi to help ensure they have wall-to-wall coverage and no dead spots. That's The Kinetic Promise™.

Internet Security: Add-on service provides a suite of security functionality including protection from cybersecurity threats, the ability to set and monitor parental controls, password vault and virtual private network ("VPN").

Our goal is to provide customers with fast, reliable, and secure broadband along with an exceptional experience and the value-added services they need to get the most out of their internet all for a competitive market price. We continue to develop and source additional solutions to better meet evolving customer needs and further differentiate Kinetic in the marketplace.

paragraphs: We face intense competitive pressures in our markets, including, but not limited to, competition from wireless companies, cable television companies, fixed wireless and satellite companies, and electric cooperatives in consumer service areas and other communications carriers or providers in business markets. Many competitors, especially wireless and cable television companies, have advantages, including substantially larger operational and financial resources, larger and more diverse networks, less stringent regulation, no carrier of last resort obligations and superior brand recognition. These entities may provide services that are competitive with the services we offer or intend to introduce.

Wireless companies also aggressively offer high-speed internet service via wireless technology to a larger geographic footprint. Customers are increasingly choosing to stop using traditional wireline phone and internet services and instead rely solely on wireless service. Cable television companies have aggressively expanded into consumer markets, offering voice, wireless and high-speed internet services in addition to video services. Some customers in the legacy Kinetic footprint have chosen to move to cable television providers for their voice, high-speed internet and television bundles. Cable television companies are subject to less stringent regulations than what we have to comply with for our consumer operations. Additionally, fixed wireless and satellite competition has contributed to a reduction in voice lines and generally has caused pricing pressure in the industry.

Additionally, some competitors have been awarded funding over a ten-year period starting in 2022 under the FCC's Rural Digital Opportunity Fund ("RDOF") program or state specific programs to expand broadband in and around the Kinetic consumer markets, increasing competitive pressures. Competition in the consumer markets could also increase as awards are determined under various state and federal broadband funding programs, including the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, via the Broadband Equity Access and Deployment Program ("BEAD"), by states and municipalities, and state specific funding programs. While we are evaluating all appropriate funding opportunities, competitors receiving awards in our markets and adjacent markets, could affect our revenues in several ways, including accelerated consumer household loss, reductions by customers in usage-based services or shifts to less profitable services and a need to lower our prices or increase marketing expenses to stay competitive, especially if the competitors are allowed to overbuild existing facilities.

In certain business markets, we purchase significant amounts of network capacity from other carriers to provide service to customers. These network facilities are owned by companies that compete directly with us for business customers. For additional information, see the risk factor "In certain operating territories and/or at certain locations, we are dependent on other carriers to provide facilities used to offer service to customers."

Our ability to compete effectively depends in part on the ability to achieve and maintain a competitive cost structure. Competition in consumer and business markets could affect future revenues and profitability in several ways, including being forced to lower prices or increase sales and marketing expense, accelerated consumer household loss, reductions by customers in usage-based services or shifts to less profitable services.

As of December 31, 2025, we had outstanding long-term indebtedness of approximately $9.5 billion, consisting of senior secured and unsecured notes, ABS Notes, term loans and revolving credit facilities provided by a syndicate of banks and other financial institutions, which, as of December 31, 2025, provided for an aggregate committed amount of additional borrowings up to approximately $540.0 million. Additionally, in the first quarter of 2026, we completed refinancing transactions which included the issuance of $1.0 billion of 8.625% secured notes. Net proceeds from the debt issuance were used to repay the $500.0 million senior secured first lien term loan facility due 2031 and for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of outstanding debt. In addition, we issued $960.1 million of secured fiber network revenue term notes with an anticipated repayment date in February 2031. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, including funding of success-based capital expenditures and the repayment of outstanding debt. As of February 23, 2026, we had outstanding long-term indebtedness of approximately $10.7 billion.

paragraphs: The following management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations describes the principal factors affecting the results of our operations, financial condition, and changes in financial condition, as well as our critical accounting estimates.

Uniti Group Inc. (herein referred to as the "Company," "Uniti," "we," "us," or "our") was incorporated in the State of Delaware on April 19, 2024, under the name "Windstream Parent, Inc." and as a subsidiary of New Windstream, LLC ("Windstream") (as successor to Windstream Holdings II, LLC) in connection with the Merger (as defined below).

Uniti is a premier digital infrastructure company with approximately 240,000 fiber route miles across 47 states. The Company serves more than 1.0 million customers, including more than 500,000 residential fiber customers, with a network that includes approximately 1.9 million fiber-equipped households predominately situated in the Midwest and Southeast United States of America ("U.S."). The Company offers a full suite of advanced communications services, including fiber-based broadband to residential and business customers, managed cloud communications and security services for large enterprises and government entities across the U.S., and tailored waves and transport solutions for carriers, content providers and large cloud computing and storage service providers in the U.S. and Canada. Our operations are organized into three business segments: Kinetic, Uniti Solutions and Fiber Infrastructure. See Notes 11 and 15 to our accompanying consolidated financial statements contained in Part II, Item 8. "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information regarding the Company's business segments.

Prior to the Merger, Uniti Group LLC (f/k/a Uniti Group Inc.) ("Old Uniti") was an independent internally managed real estate investment trust ("REIT") engaged in the acquisition, construction and leasing of mission critical infrastructure in the communications industry. Old Uniti managed its operations within two primary lines of business: Uniti Fiber and Uniti Leasing.

On August 1, 2025, pursuant to the previously announced Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of May 3, 2024 (as amended) (the "Merger Agreement"), by and between Old Uniti, Windstream, the Company, and New Windstream Merger Sub, LLC, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream ("Merger Sub"), Old Uniti and Windstream completed the following transactions: (a) Windstream merged with and into the Company (at such time, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream named Windstream Parent, Inc.), with the Company surviving the merger as the ultimate parent company of the combined company (the "Internal Reorg Merger"), and (b) Merger Sub merged with and into Old Uniti (the "Merger"), with Old Uniti surviving the Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Following the consummation of the Merger, the Company was renamed Uniti Group Inc. and Old Uniti ceased to be a REIT and the Company does not qualify to be a REIT. The common stock of the Company ("Common Stock") is listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "UNIT".

Subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger, each share of Old Uniti's common stock, par value $0.0001 per share that was issued and outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Merger was automatically cancelled and retired and converted into the right to receive 0.6029 shares of Common Stock par value $0.0001 per share, pursuant to the exchange ratio set forth in the Merger Agreement with cash issued in lieu of fractional shares. Immediately following the consummation of the Merger (the "Closing"), Old Uniti's and Windstream's pre-Closing stockholders held approximately 62% and 38%, respectively, of the Company before giving effect to the conversion of any outstanding convertible securities or the issuance of warrants to purchase Common Stock referenced below.

In connection with the Internal Reorg Merger, prior to the effective time of the Merger, Windstream's equityholders received (i) approximately 90.1 million shares of Common Stock representing approximately 35.42% of the outstanding shares of Common Stock, (ii) approximately 0.6 million shares of non-voting preferred stock of the Company ("Preferred Stock") with a dividend rate of 11% per year for the first six years, subject to an additional 0.5% per year during each of the seventh and eighth year after the initial issuance and further increased by an additional 1% per year during each subsequent year, subject to a cap of 16% per year and with an aggregate liquidation preference of $575.0 million and (iii) approximately 17.6 million warrants to purchase Common Stock, with an exercise price of $0.01 per share ("Warrants"), representing approximately 6.9% of the outstanding Common Stock immediately following the Closing on a fully diluted basis after giving effect to such warrants. Windstream's equityholders also received approximately $370.7 million in cash (net of certain transaction-related expenses) on a pro-rata basis (the "Merger Cash Consideration"). The Merger Cash Consideration was funded by Old Uniti using available cash on hand and borrowings under its Uniti Revolver (as defined herein).

The Merger was a taxable transaction for U.S. federal income tax purposes. In connection with the Merger, the Company received a favorable private letter ruling from the Internal Revenue Service regarding certain U.S. federal income tax consequences of a proposed post-closing restructuring, which was effected after the Merger. As a result of the post-closing restructuring, the Company obtained a step-up in the tax basis of certain assets of Old Uniti. See Notes 1 and 4 to the consolidated financial statements for additional information regarding the Merger.

The Merger was accounted for as a reverse merger using the acquisition method of accounting, with Windstream treated as the legal acquirer and Old Uniti treated as the accounting acquirer. Because Old Uniti is treated as the accounting acquirer, financial information for periods prior to the Merger reflect the historical activity of Old Uniti. For periods after the Merger, the consolidated financial statements reflect the combined results of Old Uniti and Windstream.

Following the completion of the Merger, we updated our segment structure to include new operating segments for the acquired Windstream businesses, combined the legacy fiber and leasing businesses into a new segment and no longer reported corporate separately. Prior period segment information has been recast to reflect these changes for all periods presented. Our reportable business segments are as follows:

Kinetic – We manage as one business our residential, business and wholesale operations in markets in which we are the incumbent local exchange carrier ("ILEC") due to the similarities with respect to service offerings and marketing strategies. Residential customers can bundle voice, high-speed internet and video services, to provide one convenient billing solution and receive bundle discounts. We offer a wide range of advanced internet services, local and long-distance voice services, integrated voice and data services, and web conferencing products to our business customers. These services are equipped to deliver high-speed internet with competitive speeds, value added services to enhance business productivity and options to bundle services to meet our business customers' needs. Products and services offered to business customers also include managed cloud communications and security services. Our Kinetic wholesale operations provide network bandwidth to other telecommunications carriers, network operators, governmental entities, content providers, and large cloud computing and storage service providers. These services include network transport services to end users, Ethernet and Wave transport of up to 400 Gigabits per second ("Gbps"), and dark fiber and colocation services. Wholesale services also include fiber-to-the-tower connections to support the wireless backhaul market. In addition, we offer voice and data carrier services to other communications providers and to larger-scale purchasers of network capacity.

Kinetic service revenues also include revenue from federal and state Universal Service Fund ("USF") programs, amounts received from the Rural Digital Opportunity Fund ("RDOF"), and certain surcharges assessed to our customers, including billings for our required contributions to federal and state USF programs. Kinetic sales revenues include sales of various types of communications equipment and products to customers, including selling network equipment to contractors on a wholesale basis.

Uniti Solutions – We manage as one business our mid-market and large business customers located within markets in which we are a competitive local exchange carrier ("CLEC") and provide services over network facilities primarily leased from other carriers. Products and services consist of software solutions and network connectivity offerings. Software solutions include Secure Access Service Edge ("SASE"), Unified Communications as a Service ("UCaaS"), OfficeSuite UC®, and associated network access products and services. SASE includes Software-Defined Wide Area Network ("SD-WAN") and Security Service Edge ("SSE") and associated network access products and services. Network connectivity offerings consist of dynamic internet protocol, dedicated internet access, multi-protocol label switching services, integrated voice and data, long distance and other managed services, including time-division multiplexing ("TDM") voice and data services and certain surcharges assessed to customers. Uniti Solutions' sales revenues include sales of high-end data and communications equipment which facilitate the delivery of advanced data and voice services to business customers.

Fiber Infrastructure – We manage as one business our legacy fiber and leasing businesses combined with the CLEC portion of Windstream's acquired wholesale business. Our Fiber Infrastructure operations are focused on providing network bandwidth to other telecommunications carriers, network operators, content providers, and large cloud computing and storage service providers. Services provided include network transport services to end users, Ethernet and Wave transport of up to 400 Gbps, and dark fiber and colocation services. Services also include fiber-to-the-tower connections to support the wireless backhaul market. In addition, we offer voice and data carrier services to other communications providers and to larger-scale purchasers of network capacity. We are also engaged in the acquisition and construction of mission-critical communications assets and leasing them to anchor customers on either an exclusive or shared-tenant basis, in addition to the leasing of dark fiber on our existing dark fiber network assets that we either constructed or acquired. Fiber Infrastructure sales revenues primarily represent amounts recognized from sales-type leases for fiber where control of the fiber has transferred to the customer.

paragraphs: Uniti Group Inc.（以下簡稱為「本公司」、「Uniti」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們的」）於2024年4月19日在德拉瓦州註冊成立，當時的公司名稱為「Windstream Parent, Inc.」，並作為New Windstream, LLC（「Windstream」）（作為Windstream Holdings II, LLC的繼承者）的子公司，與Merger（如下所定義）有關。

Uniti為一家首屈一指的數位基礎建設公司，擁有約240,000英里光纖路線，遍及47個州。本公司服務超過1.0百萬客戶，包括超過500,000戶住宅光纖客戶，其網路包含約1.9百萬戶光纖設備住宅，主要位於美國中西部與東南部（「美國」）。本公司提供完整的先進通訊服務，包括光纖寬頻服務至住宅與企業客戶、為美國大型企業與政府機構提供的管理雲端通訊與安全服務，以及為美國與加拿大電信業者、內容供應商與大型雲端計算與儲存服務供應商量身打造的波長與運輸解決方案。截至2025年12月31日財年，本公司總營收與銷售為2,234.5百萬美元，淨收入為1,304.7百萬美元。

在Merger之前，Uniti Group LLC（原為Uniti Group Inc.，簡稱為「Old Uniti」）為一家獨立內控的不動產投資信託（「REIT」），從事通訊產業中關鍵基礎建設的取得、建設與租賃。Old Uniti透過兩大主要業務線進行運作：Uniti Fiber與Uniti Leasing。Old Uniti透過常見的「up-REIT」結構運作，根據此結構，其持有幾乎所有資產透過一個合夥企業Uniti Group LP，為德拉瓦州有限合夥企業（「運營合夥企業」），由Old Uniti作為普通合夥人控制。up-REIT結構旨在促進未來的收購機會，透過讓Old Uniti能使用運營合夥企業的普通單位作為稅務效率高的收購貨幣。截至2025年8月1日，Old Uniti為運營合夥企業的唯一普通合夥人，並持有運營合夥企業100.0%的合夥權益。

2025年8月1日，根據先前公告的Merger Agreement（日期為2024年5月3日（經修正））（「Merger Agreement」），由Old Uniti、Windstream、本公司、New Uniti HoldCo LP與New Windstream Merger Sub, LLC（為Windstream間接全資子公司）之間簽訂，Old Uniti與Windstream完成以下交易：(a) Windstream與本公司合併（當時為Windstream的直接全資子公司Windstream Parent, Inc.），本公司為合併後的存續公司，成為合併後公司的最終母公司（「Internal Reorg Merger」），以及(b) Merger Sub與Old Uniti合併（「Merger」），Old Uniti為合併後的存續公司，成為本公司間接全資子公司。在Merger完成後，本公司更名為Uniti Group Inc.，Old Uniti不再為REIT，且本公司不再符合成為REIT的條件。本公司普通股（「普通股」）於納斯達克全球選選市場上市，代碼為「UNIT」。

根據Merger Agreement的條款與條件，於Merger生效時，Old Uniti所有發行在外的普通股（每股面值0.0001美元）自動註銷並退休，並轉換為取得0.6029股普通股（每股面值0.0001美元）之權利，根據Merger Agreement中的交換比率，並以現金發放以取代小數股。在Merger完成後（「Closing」），Old Uniti與Windstream的Closing前股東持有約62%與38%的本公司股份，不計任何現有可轉換證券的轉換或發行認購普通股的權證。此Merger被視為反向合併，採用收購會計方法，Windstream被視為法律上的買方，Old Uniti被視為會計上的買方。請參閱我們財務報表附註1與4，包含於本年度報告表10-K第二部分，第8項「財務報表與補充資料」中，以取得更多與Merger完成相關的資訊。
在Merger後，我們的業務運作分為三個業務部門：Kinetic、Uniti Solutions與Fiber Infrastructure，以下將更詳細說明，並請參閱我們財務報表附註15，包含於本年度報告表10-K第二部分，第8項「財務報表與補充資料」中。請參閱本年度報告表10-K第二部分，第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析—其他重大發展」，以取得2025年我們業務的重大發展資訊。

我們將住宅、企業與 Wholesale 運營視為一體，因我們在這些市場中為現有本地交換電信業者（「ILEC」），服務內容與行銷策略相似。Kinetic業務單位為一家首屈一指的多吉比特光纖寬頻、整屋Wi-Fi、網路安全與語音服務供應商，服務範圍約1,400個市場，遍及美國西南部、東南部、中西部與東北部。截至2025年12月31日財年，Kinetic部門產生總營收與銷售為928.4百萬美元，貢獻毛利為407.6百萬美元。
Kinetic的目標是透過持續投資與擴展光纖覆蓋範圍、加速用戶取得、降低用戶流失率與提高每位用戶平均收入，來實現我們寬頻網路的市場佔有率成長。消費者與小型企業的寬頻需求持續快速成長，主要驅動因素為流媒體影片、視訊會議、遠端工作、遠距醫療、遊戲、智慧家庭與連網裝置的普及。在競爭激烈的市場環境中，我們持續投資擴展光纖覆蓋範圍，對強化我們的競爭優勢與實現持續獲利成長目標至關重要。
建設光纖是吸引用戶、維持用戶以及增加營業收入的關鍵驅動因素，我們預期隨時間推移，這一點將變得更加重要。我們持續以光纖取代銅線，以提供對稱的千兆加速度、增強的可靠性、更好的支援以及未來可持續的連線。除了對我們的寬頻網路進行投資外，我們也致力於提供可持續的、有盈利性的用戶成長，並透過具吸引力且具價值的服務與產品組合、行銷與銷售效率以及更佳的用戶體驗來達成此目標。
我們為消費者與小型企業提供透過我們的光纖與銅線網路的服務組合，包括寬頻上網、語音服務以及其他附加價值服務。Kinetic 的住宅與小型企業服務包括：

用戶端設備（Customer Premise Equipment，CPE）：用戶可租賃 Kinetic 的先進 Wi-Fi 網關。具體而言，住宅用戶可租賃 eero Pro 7，該設備採用最新、最進階的 Wi-Fi 7 技術。當搭配 Kinetic 的光纖上網時，eero Pro 7 可提供更優質的線上體驗，具備易用、安全、快速且經濟實惠的特點。我們也提供最先進的 mesh 延伸器，讓用戶可於家中各處強化訊號。
Kinetic 承諾™：包含 Kinetic 全屋 Wi-Fi 安裝服務的承諾，即技術人員不會在新光纖安裝完成前離開，直到 Wi-Fi 在家中每間房間及每種裝置上都能正常運作。專業技術人員會為用戶設置並安裝其 Wi-Fi，以確保用戶擁有從牆到牆的覆蓋範圍，並無訊號死角。這就是 Kinetic 承諾™。
網路安全：附加服務提供一整套安全功能，包括防禦網路安全威脅、設定並監控家長控制、密碼保險箱以及虛擬私人網路（"VPN"）。
我們的目標是為用戶提供快速、可靠且安全的寬頻服務，並搭配卓越的體驗以及用戶所需的附加價值服務，以具競爭力的市場價格提供。我們持續開發並取得更多解決方案，以更好地符合用戶需求的演進，並進一步區隔 Kinetic 在市場上的競爭優勢。

headings: 完成與 Windstream 的合併
合併銷售、一般及行政費用（"SG&A"）
paragraphs: 以下為管理層對財務狀況及營運結果之討論與分析，說明影響我們營運結果、財務狀況及財務狀況變動之主要因素，以及我們關鍵會計估計。
Uniti Group Inc.（以下簡稱為「本公司」、「Uniti」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們」）於2024年4月19日在特拉華州成立，當時名稱為「Windstream Parent, Inc.」，並為New Windstream, LLC（「Windstream」）（作為Windstream Holdings II, LLC之繼承者）之子公司，與Merger（如下所定）有關。

Uniti為一家首屈一指的數位基礎建設公司，擁有約240,000英里光纖路線，遍及47個州。本公司服務超過1.0百萬客戶，包括超過500,000戶住宅光纖客戶，其網路包含約1.9百萬具光纖設備之住宅，主要位於美國中西部及東南部（「美國」）。本公司提供完整的先進通訊服務，包括光纖寬頻服務給住宅及企業客戶，為美國政府機構及大型企業提供管理雲端通訊及安全服務，並為美國及加拿大之電信業者、內容供應商及大型雲端計算與儲存服務供應商提供客製化波長及運輸解決方案。我們的營運分為三個業務分部：Kinetic、Uniti Solutions及Fiber Infrastructure。請參閱本年度10-K申報書第二部分，第8項「財務資料與補充資料」所附之綜合財務報表附註第11項及第15項，以取得更多關於本公司業務分部之資訊。
在合併前，Uniti Group LLC（原為Uniti Group Inc.）（「Old Uniti」）為一獨立內控管理之不動產投資信託（「REIT」），從事通訊產業之資產取得、建設及租賃。Old Uniti透過兩個主要業務線進行營運：Uniti Fiber及Uniti Leasing。

於2025年8月1日，根據先前公告之合併協議，於2024年5月3日簽訂（後經修正）（「合併協議」），由Old Uniti、Windstream、本公司及New Windstream Merger Sub, LLC（為Windstream之間接全資子公司）之間簽訂，Old Uniti與Windstream完成以下交易：(a) Windstream與本公司合併（於合併時，為Windstream之直接全資子公司Windstream Parent, Inc.），本公司為合併後之存續公司，成為合併後公司之最終母公司（「內部重組合併」），以及(b) Merger Sub與Old Uniti合併（「合併」），Old Uniti為合併後之存續公司，成為本公司之間接全資子公司。合併完成後，本公司更名為Uniti Group Inc.，Old Uniti不再符合REIT之資格，本公司亦無法符合REIT之資格。本公司普通股（「普通股」）於納斯達克全球選選市場上市，代碼為「UNIT」。

根據合併協議之條款與條件，於合併生效時，Old Uniti所有發行且在合併生效時仍在流通之普通股，自動註銷並退休，並轉換為取得0.6029股普通股之權利（每股面值為0.0001美元），根據合併協議之交換比率，並以現金發行以取代小數股數。合併完成後（「閉幕」），Old Uniti及Windstream之閉幕前股東持有本公司約62%及38%之股份，不計任何未償還可轉換證券或發行認購普通股權之轉換後之影響。

根據內部重組合併，在合併生效時，Windstream之股東收到(i)約90.1百萬股普通股，代表約35.42%之普通股發行股份，(ii)約0.6百萬股非投票優先股（「優先股」），年 dividend 率為11%於前六年，於第七及第八年每年增加0.5%，於隨後每年再增加1%，但年上限為16%，並有總計575.0百萬美元之清算優先權，以及(iii)約17.6百萬認購普通股權，每股行使價格為0.01美元（「認購權」），代表於閉幕後，經此認購權影響後，約6.9%之普通股發行股份。Windstream之股東亦收到約370.7百萬美元現金（扣除某些交易相關費用）按比例分配（「合併現金對價」）。此合併現金對價由Old Uniti使用現金及其Uniti Revolver（如下所定）之貸款資金支應。
此合併為美國聯邦所得稅目的之課稅交易。根據合併，本公司獲得美國國稅局之有利私人書面裁定，關於某項合併後之重組之美國聯邦所得稅後果，此重組於合併後實施。因此，本公司取得Old Uniti之部分資產之稅基提高。請參閱綜合財務報表附註第1項及第4項，以取得更多關於此合併之資訊。
本次合併以反向合併方式會計處理，採用收購法會計，Windstream 被視為法律上的買方，Old Uniti 被視為會計上的買方。因為 Old Uniti 被視為會計上的買方，因此合併前的財務資訊反映 Old Uniti 的歷史活動。合併後的財務報表則反映 Old Uniti 與 Windstream 合併後的結果。
完成合併後，我們更新了營運分部結構，以包含新取得的 Windstream 事業的營運分部，將原有的光纖與租賃業務合併為一個新分部，並不再單獨報告公司層級。先前期間的分部資訊已重新整理，以反映這些變更，適用於所有呈報期間。我們的應報告分部如下：

Kinetic – 我們將住宅、企業與 Wholesale 業務視為一個營運業務，在我們為現有本地交換電信業者（"ILEC"）的市場中，由於服務內容與行銷策略的相似性。住宅客戶可將語音、高速網路與視訊服務組合，以提供一個方便的帳單解決方案並享有組合折扣。我們為企業客戶提供廣泛的先進網路服務、本地與長途語音服務、整合語音與數據服務，以及網路會議產品。這些服務能提供高速網路與競爭性速度、增強企業生產力的附加服務，以及符合企業客戶需求的服務組合。提供給企業客戶的產品與服務也包括管理雲端通訊與安全服務。我們的 Kinetic Wholesale 業務為其他電信業者、網路運營商、政府機構、內容供應商及大型雲端計算與儲存服務供應商提供網路頻寬。這些服務包括對終端用戶的網路傳輸服務、最高達 400 億比特每秒（"Gbps"）的以太網與波長傳輸，以及暗纖與機房服務。Wholesale 服務也包括至電塔的光纖連接，以支持無線回傳市場。此外，我們也為其他通訊供應商及較大規模的網路容量購買者提供語音與數據電信服務。
Kinetic 服務收入也包含來自聯邦與州級普遍服務基金（"USF"）計畫的收入、來自鄉村數位機會基金（"RDOF"）的金額，以及某些對客戶收取的附加費，包括我們對聯邦與州級 USF 計畫的必要貢獻的帳單。Kinetic 銷售收入包含向客戶銷售各種類型的通訊設備與產品，包括以 Wholesale 方式向承包商銷售網路設備。

Uniti Solutions – 我們將中型市場與大型企業客戶視為一個營運業務，在我們為競爭性本地交換電信業者（"CLEC"）的市場中，並透過主要向其他電信業者租賃的網路設施提供服務。產品與服務包括軟體解決方案與網路連線方案。軟體解決方案包括安全存取服務邊緣（"SASE"）、統一通訊即服務（"UCaaS"）、OfficeSuite UC®，以及相關的網路存取產品與服務。SASE 包含軟體定義廣域網路（"SD-WAN"）與安全服務邊緣（"SSE"），以及相關的網路存取產品與服務。網路連線方案包括動態 IP、專用 IP 連線、多協議標籤交換服務、整合語音與數據、長途電話及其他管理服務，包括時分多路複用（"TDM"）語音與數據服務，以及某些對客戶收取的附加費。Uniti Solutions 的銷售收入包含銷售高階數據與通訊設備，這些設備用以提供先進數據與語音服務給企業客戶。

Fiber Infrastructure – 我們將原有的光纖與租賃業務與 Windstream 取得的 Wholesale 事業中 CLEC 部分合併，作為一個營運業務。我們的 Fiber Infrastructure 業務專注於為其他電信業者、網路運營商、內容供應商及大型雲端計算與儲存服務供應商提供網路頻寬。提供的服務包括對終端用戶的網路傳輸服務、最高達 400 億比特每秒（"Gbps"）的以太網與波長傳輸，以及暗纖與機房服務。服務也包括至電塔的光纖連接，以支持無線回傳市場。此外，我們也為其他通訊供應商及較大規模的網路容量購買者提供語音與數據電信服務。我們也參與關鍵通訊資產的取得與建設，並將其出租給主要客戶，以獨佔或共用租戶的方式，同時也出租我們現有暗纖網路資產上的暗纖，這些資產我們已建設或取得。Fiber Infrastructure 的銷售收入主要來自於銷售型租賃的光纖收入，其中光纖的控制權已轉移至客戶。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
消費者服務領域的競爭及過度建設，以及企業市場的競爭，可能會降低市場佔有率，並對我們的營運結果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們的負債水平可能會對我們的財務狀況產生重大且不利的影響，包括減少用於其他業務用途的資金，以及降低我們的營運彈性。
網路安全事件可能會對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
若物理或內部系統基礎設施或服務出現故障，可能會導致重大成本及中斷。
科技快速變遷可能影響我們的競爭能力。
持續增加的寬頻使用量可能會導致網路容量限制，進而造成服務中斷或客戶容量減少。
在某些營運地區及/或特定地點，我們依賴其他電信業者提供用以向客戶提供服務的設施。
若我們被禁止參與政府計畫，營運結果可能受到重大且不利的影響。
我們目前正面臨聲請，未來可能面臨更多聲請及新的合規、法規或其他義務或負債，與銅網路資產中含有的鉛有關。

paragraphs: 我們在市場面臨強烈的競爭壓力，包括但不限於無線電公司、有線電視公司、固定無線和衛星公司、以及電力合作社在消費者服務區域和其他通訊電信業者在企業市場的競爭。許多競爭對手，尤其是無線電公司和有線電視公司，具有優勢，包括大幅較大的運營和財務資源、更大且更多樣化的網路、較少的嚴格監管、無最後電信業者義務，以及更強的品牌認知度。這些機構可能提供與我們所提供的服務或預計推出的服務具有競爭力的服務。

無線電公司也積極提供透過無線技術的高速互聯網服務，覆蓋更廣的地理區域。客戶越來越傾向於停止使用傳統的線路電話和互聯網服務，並改為僅依賴無線服務。有線電視公司積極擴張至消費者市場，提供語音、無線和高速互聯網服務，除了影片服務。一些在傳統Kinetic服務範圍的客戶已選擇轉移到有線電視供應商，以取得語音、高速互聯網和電視套餐。有線電視公司受到的監管較我們在消費者業務運營所面對的監管較為寬鬆。此外，固定無線和衛星競爭已導致語音線路減少，並普遍造成產業內的價格壓力。

此外，一些競爭對手已獲得在2022年起十年內的資金，透過FCC的鄉村數位機會基金（"RDOF"）計畫或州級特定計畫，以擴展寬頻至Kinetic消費者市場及其周邊地區，增加競爭壓力。消費者市場的競爭也可能因各州和聯邦寬頻資金計畫，包括《基礎建設投資與就業法案》，透過寬頻公平存取與部署計畫（"BEAD"），由各州和地方政府以及州級特定資金計畫所決定而增加。雖然我們正在評估所有適當的資金機會，但在我們市場和鄰近市場獲得獎勵的競爭對手，可能以多種方式影響我們的收入，包括加速消費者家庭流失、客戶減少用量基準服務或轉向較不盈利的服務，以及需要降低我們的價格或增加行銷費用以保持競爭力，特別是如果競爭對手被允許過度建設現有設施。
在某些企業市場，我們從其他電信業者購買大量網路容量，以提供服務給客戶。這些網路設施由與我們在企業客戶市場直接競爭的公司所擁有。有關更多資訊，請參閱風險因素 "在某些運營地區或特定地點，我們依賴其他電信業者提供用以提供服務給客戶的設施。"
我們能有效競爭的能力，在一定程度上取決於實現並維持具有競爭力的成本結構。消費者和企業市場的競爭可能以多種方式影響未來收入和利潤，包括被迫降低價格或增加銷售和行銷費用、加速消費者家庭流失、客戶減少用量基準服務或轉向較不盈利的服務。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司尚有約9.5十億美元之長期負債，包含高級 secured 並未 secured notes、ABS Notes、定期貸款及由銀行與其他金融機構組成之聯貸機構所提供之循環信貸融資，於2025年12月31日，該等融資提供總計約540.0百萬美元之額外借款承諾金額。此外，於2026年第一季，本公司完成再融資交易，包含發行1.0十億美元之8.625% secured notes。債務發行之淨所得用以償還2031年到期之500.0百萬美元高級 secured 第一留置權定期貸款融資，並用於一般企業用途，包含償還現有負債。此外，本公司發行960.1百萬美元之secured 光纖網路營收定期貸款notes，預期償還日期為2031年2月。本公司預計將此次發行之淨所得用於一般企業用途，包含資本支出之資金及償還現有負債。截至2026年2月23日，本公司尚有約10.7十億美元之長期負債。
